sinopsis.es: Fernández lleva 25 años en la misma ferretería junto a don Vila, un anciano que ha prometido dejarle todo cuando muera. Empieza a frecuentar a la señorita Plasini, a quien su desconcertante madre mantiene vigilada. Con una boda posible crecen el afán de heredar y la ansiedad. Un melodrama de desasosiego ante el capitalismo y su idea del éxito.
sinopsis.en: Fernández has spent 25 years at the same hardware store with Mr. Vila, an old man who has promised to leave him everything when he dies. He begins seeing Miss Plasini, whose unsettling mother keeps her under watch. With a wedding possible, his eagerness to inherit and his anxiety grow. A melodrama of unease at capitalism and its idea of success.
